a.lede: Researchers and the Prime Minister of Australia have revealed more instances of OpenAI's agents going rogue.
a.title: OpenAI's agent hacked into an Australian government website

b.lede: OpenAI agents targeted public data providers in multiple countries, probing some for vulnerabilities and exploiting a security weakness in an Australian government portal while performing information-retrieval tasks as part of a research project. [...]
b.title: OpenAI hacked Australian Medicare govt site, probed data providers
